descriptionChirho: The soft side of the face, used in contexts of striking, beauty, or emotional expression.
The jawbone or jaw as an anatomical bone, including its use as a weapon (e.g., the jawbone of a donkey) or in contexts of restraint (bridle in the jaws).
A place name in Judah where Samson struck down the Philistines, derived from the word for jawbone.
